description:
Convert Simplified and Traditional Chinese text locally with OpenCC on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Choose from four presets: Simplified Chinese, OpenCC Traditional, Taiwan Standard with Taiwan idioms, and Hong Kong Traditional. Advanced variant and regional wording options remain available. Simplified output is not a complete reverse conversion of Taiwan-specific vocabulary.

Import or drop one UTF-8 TXT file up to 10 MiB, with or without a BOM. Export the latest successful result as UTF-8 without a BOM. Line endings, blank lines and Unicode characters are preserved through file handling. Big5 and GBK files must first be saved as UTF-8. Batch conversion and files over 10 MiB are not supported in this version, including with Pro.

Use side-by-side or stacked source/result panes on Mac and iPad. Narrow windows adapt to stacked panes; iPhone uses a stacked workspace. Cancel conversion or import to prevent a late result from replacing your current text.

Free users get 12 successful homepage conversions per day, shared across windows. Import, export and changing presets do not use this allowance. Lifetime Pro is a one-time purchase that removes this daily homepage limit and the in-app recommendations. Restore a previous purchase or open purchase support from Settings.

OpenCCman converts Chinese characters and wording; it does not translate Mandarin to Cantonese, generate pinyin or expose Japanese Shinjitai conversion.

Open source under the MIT license: https://github.com/gewill/OpenCCman
whatsNew:
Four conversion presets and a single UTF-8 TXT import/export workflow, up to 10 MiB.
Adaptive source/result layouts for Mac and iPad, plus a stacked iPhone workspace.
Cancel conversion or import without accepting late results.
Purchase support in Settings and shared daily homepage quota across windows.
